commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

88' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
87' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) trips an opposition player and Christian Dingert signals a foul. Mainz earn a free kick.
84' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
83' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Scott Banks (St. Pauli) replaces Johannes Eggestein.
83' That's the end of the game for Philipp Treu, who is replaced by Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli).
83' Substitution. Nadiem Amiri makes his way off the pitch and Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz) comes on as his replacement.
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Moritz Jenz (Mainz) was quite harsh and Christian Dingert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

75' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
73' The attendance for today's match is 29546.
70' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
68' Christian Dingert blows his whistle after Elias Saad (St. Pauli) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Mainz are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
65' Armindo Sieb will be replaced by Paul Nebel (Mainz).
63' Alexander Blessin prepares a substitution. Oladapo Afolayan is replaced by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).

62' 0 - 3 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Nadiem Amiri finds Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
61' Robert Wagner (St. Pauli) makes a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul. Mainz get a free kick.
58' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Zentner punches the ball away.

57' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
57' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' Anthony Caci (Mainz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
55' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Christian Dingert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Mainz have been awarded a free kick.
52' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
50' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
50' St. Pauli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
49' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) picks up a yellow card.

45+1' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+1' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.

39' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) but poses no threat.
37' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is able to continue to play.

35' The free kick from long range, taken by Mainz, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
34' Christian Dingert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Elias Saad (St. Pauli) and blew his whistle. Mainz are awarded a free kick.
34' The total number of attempts is 7:3.
32' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) squanders a huge chance from point blank range. His volley is directed towards the right side of the goal, but Robin Zentner is alert and makes an amazing save!
31' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.

28' A neat pass is well received by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.

27' A short pass from Johannes Eggestein puts Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.

24' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Robin Zentner leaps like a salmon to deny him.
20' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Armindo Sieb (Mainz) for his blatant foul.

20' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
16' 0 - 2 Goal! A great through ball by Nadiem Amiri sets up Armindo Sieb (Mainz) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:2.

15' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
15' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Another situation results in a direct free kick for St. Pauli.

15' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) was too forceful with his tackle and Christian Dingert interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to St. Pauli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

12' That was close by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
12' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Robin Zentner gets down to his right to keep it out.
11' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
9' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

9' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Christian Dingert blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. That's a free kick to St. Pauli.
8' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes.
